query_text_zh: 做一个网页应用，可以上传学习笔记，然后把笔记内容转成我能练习的测验——我想选一个笔记文件，得到一组基于实际内容的问题，逐一作答，最后看到哪些答错了，知道哪里需要复习。

query_text_zh: 做一个每日短时学习计划的网页应用——我可以安排每天要上的微课，完成后打勾，看到哪些天完成了哪些天落下了的简单记录，全部在一个地方管理，不会不知不觉就失去节奏。

query_text_zh: 做一个思维导图工具网页应用，可以把想法和概念用可视化的方式连接起来——我想为不同主题创建多个导图，给每个节点添加笔记，在桌面浏览器里按名称快速调出任意一张导图，让所有思路都整理在一处。

query_text_zh: 做一个乐理自学追踪网页应用，可以记录每次练习时段、标注涵盖的主题——比如和弦进行、音阶、听音训练——完成练习后打勾，在浏览器里打开就能一眼看出练了哪些、还有哪些需要关注。

query_text_zh: 做一个网页应用追踪我的终身学习目标——列出想学或想精通的事情，每项有可以逐个打勾的里程碑，还能记录开始日期和完成日期，在桌面浏览器里回顾多年来自己真正实现了哪些。

query_text_zh: 做一个深度研究笔记网页应用，可以把查到的所有内容整理成文，附上带规范引用的来源，按主题或子主题组织笔记——我想要一个浏览器里的工具，帮我为自己建立全面的参考库，不再丢失信息来源。

query_text_zh: 需要一个网页追踪工具，在一个地方显示我的总净资产——手动输入存款、投资、房产、退休账户等各类资产，按类别拆解，能看到每块资金占比和总额随时间的变化，不用每个月重新搭一次电子表格。

query_text_zh: 做一个专为独立创作者设计的看板网页应用——我想要待办、进行中、已完成等列，可以添加带简短描述和截止日期的任务卡，拖动卡片跨列移动来更新进度，全部在浏览器里管理，不需要完整团队工具那么臃肿。

query_text: A web app for an open-source grant program — visitors can learn about the funding on the home page, browse past grant recipients to get a sense of what kinds of projects get picked, and fill out an application form right in the browser, so maintainers can apply for support without a bunch of back-and-forth email.
query_text_zh: 做一个开源资助项目的网页应用——首页介绍资助详情，可以浏览历届获资助项目了解哪类项目会被选中，还能直接在浏览器里填写申请表，让维护者不用来回发邮件就能申请支持。

corpus_topic: Developer productivity benchmark results showcase page
query_text: Create a website that shows off developer productivity benchmark results — like a comparison of how much faster or more efficient a tool makes things, with some simple charts and real numbers, maybe a few quotes from people who ran the tests, all laid out for desktop browsers so companies can share it with their teams as a reference.
query_text_zh: 做一个网站，展示开发者生产力的基准测试结果——比如某个工具让效率提升了多少，配上简洁的图表和真实数据，也许加几句参与测试的人的评价，整体为桌面浏览器设计，方便公司分享给团队作为参考。

corpus_topic: Infrastructure-as-code tool go-to-market homepage
query_text: Make a web app that acts like a homepage for a tool that helps teams set up servers and cloud stuff automatically — I want it to show what the tool does, have a spot that walks through the main steps of getting started, and a little section at the bottom where people can sign up or try it out.
query_text_zh: 做一个网页应用，作为一款帮助团队自动化搭建服务器和云资源的工具的主页——展示工具功能，有一个模块引导用户完成入门的主要步骤，底部有一个小区域让人注册或试用。

corpus_topic: freelance developer marketplace with milestone-based escrow
query_text: A web app for hiring freelance developers where clients can post jobs and developers can apply, with the money held safely in the middle until each agreed milestone is done — the home screen should show open jobs and a list of top-rated developers so both sides can easily find what they need.
query_text_zh: 做一个招募自由开发者的网页应用，客户可以发布项目需求，开发者可以投标，资金在中间安全托管，直到每个约定里程碑完成才释放——首页显示开放中的项目和顶级开发者列表，方便双方快速找到所需。

corpus_topic: engineering team capacity billing and invoice generator
query_text: Make a web app billing tool that lets an engineering team log how many hours or people they put into each project, then automatically spits out an invoice you can send to the client, so I stop having to do all that math and formatting by hand every month.
query_text_zh: 做一个网页版账单工具，让工程团队记录每个项目投入的工时或人力，然后自动生成可以发给客户的发票，我不想每个月都手动算数、排版。

corpus_topic: technical due diligence report ordering platform
query_text: Build a web app where companies can order a technical review of a startup or software product they're thinking about investing in — they fill out a form describing the company and what they want checked, pick from a few report types, and can track the status of their order until the finished report is ready to download.
query_text_zh: 做一个网页应用，让公司可以下单委托对他们考虑投资的初创公司或软件产品进行技术尽调——填写表单描述公司信息和审查重点，选择报告类型，然后追踪订单状态，直到最终报告可以下载为止。

corpus_topic: software license key management and renewal dashboard
query_text: Build a web app that keeps track of all the software licenses and activation keys our team uses, shows when each one is coming up for renewal, and sends a reminder before it expires so we stop getting caught off guard by lapsed subscriptions.
query_text_zh: 做一个网页应用，统一管理团队使用的所有软件许可证和激活码，显示每个许可证的到期日期，并在到期前发送提醒，这样就不会再被突然失效的订阅打个措手不及。

corpus_topic: developer-focused contract and invoice generation site
query_text: Create a web app tool for freelance developers to fill in their client info and project details, then get a ready-to-send contract and an invoice generated right away — something that stops me from having to rewrite the same boilerplate every single time I start a new project.
query_text_zh: 做一个网页工具，让自由开发者填入客户信息和项目详情，立刻生成可以直接发送的合同和发票——不想每次开新项目都要重新写一遍一模一样的模板内容。

corpus_topic: API monetization and revenue analytics dashboard
query_text: A browser-based tracker app for developers selling access to their API — shows how much money is coming in each day and which pricing plans are most popular, so I can actually tell at a glance whether the thing is making money or not.
query_text_zh: 做一个浏览器端的追踪应用，给那些出售 API 访问权限的开发者用——显示每天的收入情况和各定价方案的受欢迎程度，这样一眼就能看出来有没有在赚钱。

corpus_topic: SQL practice sandbox with curated real-world datasets
query_text: Make a web app SQL practice tool that comes loaded with real datasets like sales records or employee tables, lets me write and run queries right there in the browser, and shows me whether my query got the right answer — I want a list of practice challenges on one side and the results on the other so I can work through them one by one.
query_text_zh: 做一个网页版 SQL 练习工具，内置销售记录、员工表等真实数据集，可以直接在浏览器里写查询并运行，并告诉我答案对不对——左边是练习题列表，右边显示结果，方便逐题练习。

corpus_topic: Git branching and merge conflict interactive simulator
query_text: Create a web app simulator for learning how Git branches and merges work, where I can create branches, make pretend commits, and see what happens when two branches conflict — I want it to show the branch history visually and walk me through resolving a conflict step by step.
query_text_zh: 做一个网页应用，模拟学习 Git 分支和合并的过程，可以创建分支、模拟提交，看看两个分支冲突会发生什么——希望能可视化显示分支历史，并一步一步引导我解决冲突。

corpus_topic: Regex pattern builder with live test and plain-English explanation
query_text: Build a web app regex builder tool where I type in a pattern, paste in some sample text, and it highlights the matches in real time — the key thing I want is a plain-English breakdown that explains what each part of the pattern actually does, so I can actually learn instead of just guessing.
query_text_zh: 做一个网页版正则表达式构建工具，我输入一个模式、粘贴一段示例文本，实时高亮匹配结果——最重要的是要有通俗的中文解释，说明模式里每一部分的作用，这样我能真正学会，而不只是靠猜。

corpus_topic: Cloud certification study guide and practice exam site
query_text: Make a web app study tool for cloud certification exams — I want a list of topics I can work through one by one, practice questions with explanations after I answer, and a progress tracker so I can see which areas I still need to review before test day.
query_text_zh: 做一个网页版云认证考试学习工具——有一个知识点列表可以逐一学习，有带解析的练习题，还有进度追踪，让我看到考前哪些领域还需要复习。

corpus_topic: Software design patterns catalog with runnable code examples

query_text_zh: 需要一个浏览器端的参考应用，列出所有常见软件设计模式，比如单例、观察者、工厂，每个都有通俗的使用场景说明，以及一个可以实际运行的小代码示例，看看它的行为表现。

corpus_topic: Web performance optimization techniques lab and reference
query_text: Make a web app learning tool focused on making websites load faster — it should have a list of techniques like image compression and caching with a short explanation of each, plus a little playground where I can toggle things on and off and see how they affect load time so I can actually understand what each trick does.
query_text_zh: 做一个网页版学习工具，专注于网站加载速度优化——列出图片压缩、缓存等各种技术，每项都有简短说明，还有一个小实验区，可以切换开关看看各项对加载时间的影响，这样才能真正理解每个技巧的作用。

corpus_topic: annotated code review examples learning community
query_text: A web app community site where developers share real code snippets from pull requests with notes explaining what was wrong or could be better — people can browse by topic, add their own comments, and upvote the examples that taught them something useful.
query_text_zh: 做一个网页版开发者社区，大家可以分享 PR 里的真实代码片段，并附上注解说明哪里有问题或可以优化——可以按主题浏览，添加评论，给那些让自己有收获的例子点赞。

corpus_topic: developer mentorship pairing and progress tracking site
query_text: Create a web app for matching junior developers with more experienced mentors — someone fills out what they want to learn, gets paired with a mentor, and then both people can log their sessions and see how the mentee is progressing over time.
query_text_zh: 做一个网页应用，为初级开发者匹配更有经验的导师——用户填写想学什么，系统配对导师，然后双方都可以记录每次辅导情况，追踪学员的进步轨迹。

corpus_topic: tech conference talk archive with community annotations
query_text: A browser-based archive app for tech conference talks where you can search or filter by topic or year, watch or read through a talk, and leave notes or highlights that other people can also see — so the community's insights stick around instead of getting lost.
query_text_zh: 做一个浏览器端的技术会议演讲资料库，可以按主题或年份搜索或筛选，在线观看或阅读演讲内容，还能留下笔记和高亮供其他人看到——让社区的见解留存下来，而不是就此消失。

corpus_topic: competitive programming leaderboard and contest hub
query_text: Make a web app hub for competitive programming where people can join coding contests, see a live leaderboard that updates as solutions are submitted, and browse past contest problems with the highest-ranked solutions shown alongside them.
query_text_zh: 做一个网页版竞技编程平台，用户可以参加编程比赛，实时排行榜随着题目提交不断更新，还能浏览历届比赛题目，并看到最高分解法。

corpus_topic: developer side-project launch and feedback board
query_text: Need a web app where developers can post their little side projects to get early feedback from other builders — each project has a short description and a link to try it, and visitors can leave quick reactions or comments so the maker knows what's working and what's confusing.
query_text_zh: 需要一个网页应用，让开发者发布自己的小项目来收集其他开发者的早期反馈——每个项目有简短介绍和试用链接，访客可以快速留下反应或评论，让创作者知道哪里做对了、哪里让人困惑。

corpus_topic: open-source contributor stats and recognition site
query_text: Need a web app that pulls in stats for open-source contributors — things like how many pull requests they've merged, which projects they've helped with, and a little public profile page that highlights their best contributions so their work actually gets some recognition.
query_text_zh: 需要一个网页应用，汇总开源贡献者的统计数据——比如合并了多少 PR、参与了哪些项目，还有一个公开主页展示他们最亮眼的贡献，让大家的付出得到应有的认可。

corpus_topic: Open-source license chooser and side-by-side comparator
query_text: Build a web app tool that helps me figure out which open-source license to use for my project — I answer a few questions about what I want people to be able to do with my code, and it recommends a couple options and shows them side by side so I can actually understand the difference before I pick one.
query_text_zh: 做一个网页工具，帮我选择适合项目的开源许可证——我回答几个关于想让别人怎么使用我代码的问题，工具推荐几个选项并并排展示，让我在选择前真正搞清楚它们的区别。

corpus_topic: HTTP status code reference and live tester
query_text: A browser-based reference tool for all the HTTP status codes — I want to look up what any code means, see a plain-English explanation of when a server would send it, and have a little spot where I can fire off a test request to a URL and see what code comes back.
query_text_zh: 做一个浏览器端的 HTTP 状态码参考工具——可以查任意状态码的含义，看到服务器在什么情况下会返回它的通俗解释，还有一个小区域让我向某个 URL 发一个测试请求，看看实际返回什么状态码。

corpus_topic: Environment variable manager and dotenv file generator
query_text: Create a web app tool for managing environment variables across different projects — I can add key-value pairs for each project, organize them by environment like dev or production, and then download a ready-to-use .env file so I stop copying stuff around by hand.
query_text_zh: 做一个网页工具，统一管理不同项目的环境变量——可以为每个项目添加键值对，按开发、生产等环境分类，然后下载一个可以直接用的 .env 文件，不用再手动到处复制粘贴。

query_text: Build a web app tool that gives me a unique URL I can point a webhook at, then shows every request that hits it in real time — I want to see the headers, the body, and the timestamp for each incoming request so I can figure out what my service is actually sending.
query_text_zh: 做一个网页工具，给我一个唯一的 URL 可以接收 webhook，然后实时显示每一条打进来的请求——我想看到每个请求的请求头、请求体和时间戳，这样才能搞清楚我的服务实际在发送什么。

query_text_zh: 做一个面向开发者的网页版转换工具，支持 Base64 编解码、URL 编码以及其他几种常用文本格式——左边粘贴内容，选择转换方式，右边立即在浏览器里显示结果。

query_text_zh: 做一个浏览器端的 Unix 时间戳转换工具——粘贴一个数字就能看到它对应的精确日期和时间，也可以选一个日期反查时间戳，还带时区选择器，方便查看不同地区对应的时间。
